Docket 1.3.151

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A free score card.* The free version now saves a score card: one picture with the site, its score and grade, how many
  pages were checked and how many problems each area found. Press Save score card on the result and send it to a client
  or a colleague. It says nothing about what the problems are or how to fix them.
- *Reports link back to Docket.* The footer of a report that is Docket's own, in HTML, Markdown and PDF, now links to
  docketseo.app. A white-labelled report is unchanged: it names the agency and carries no link.

99 checks across 13 areas.
